findings.text: blocking: the review-dispatch done_when at reckon/crew/recovery.py:663 still spells the dimension count as the literal 5 ("stores a parsed record scoring all 5 dimensions in the range 0..20") against a six-dimension schema (review.REVIEW_DIMENSIONS = goal_fidelity, evidence, scope_discipline, durability, fit, reuse); a review node following that brief scores five dimensions and stores a record whose absent=['reuse'] leaves total None, which recovery._review_is_complete rejects and recovery._review_accepts_promotion can never accept, so the stale literal disables the acceptance path it was written to describe. The plan's own done-when grep (grep -Przo 'five[-\s]+dimension|5 dimension' reckon/ --include=*.py) and the run's static-check both miss it because the source splits the literal across a string continuation ("all 5 " newline "dimensions ..."), the exact line-break escape §7 warns about; consecutive-string-concatenation-aware sweep of reckon/ returns this one site and no other. This node's own dispatch done-when carried the stale "5" verbatim, demonstrating the harm.

justifications.evidence: the run records the defect reproducing at base (reproduction.log: dimensions=6 maximum=120 floor=90 total=90 accepted=True) and the fix at head (head-probe.log: floor 108 total 90 accepted=False), the focused gate is 131 passed EXIT=0 with a proper header, and the negative control is 2 failed EXIT=1; against that, static-check.log claims 0 prose matches, a false negative that leaves the residual literal unreported.
justifications.fit: the edited lines match the surrounding style, the prose rewrites read naturally, and the new test uses the repository's parametrized boundary idiom without adding a mechanism.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the floor now derives from the six-dimension schema and the acceptance boundary is proven both sides, but the done-when clause that no other site spells the count as a literal is false: reckon/crew/recovery.py:663 still hardcodes "all 5 dimensions", so the node's stated done-when is not fully met.
justifications.reuse: the floor reads its count from the schema's single owner, review.REVIEW_DIMENSIONS, rather than duplicating the number, so a dimension added to the tuple moves the floor with it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is 33 insertions and 8 deletions across exactly the reviewed run's four declared write paths, and no file outside them changed.
